questions.cardText:
[Linguistics] Which of the following languages is a tonal language?
A. Hawaiian
B. Swahili
C. Hmong
Answer: C. Hmong is a tonal language, meaning the pitch or tone used when pronouncing a word can change its meaning.
questions.de: Wie viele unterschiedliche Töne verwendet die Tonsprache Weißes Hmong (Hmong Daw)?
questions.en: How many distinct tones does the tonal language White Hmong (Hmong Daw) use?

timeline.labelEn: Missionaries and Hmong advisers in Laos create the Romanized Popular Alphabet for Hmong (1951–1953)
timeline.labelDe: Missionare und Hmong-Berater in Laos schaffen die lateinische Hmong-Schrift RPA (1951–1953)

questions.notes: Asked as a fact about Hmong's tones: Hmong Daw and Mong Leeg have seven tones, Dananshan eight (Wikipedia). Hawaiian and Swahili are not tonal.

questions.cardText:
[History] Which ancient civilization is commonly credited with first proposing that the Earth is round?
A. Greeks B. Babylonians C. Chinese
Answer: A. The philosopher Pythagoras suggested the idea in the 6th century BCE, and later, Aristotle provided observational evidence supporting the spherical Earth model in the 4th century BCE. There is also some suggestive evidence that the Egyptians perceived the Earth to be round even earlier.
questions.de: In den Schriften der Philosophen welches antiken Volkes taucht um das 5. Jahrhundert v. Chr. erstmals die Vorstellung einer kugelförmigen Erde auf?
questions.en: In the writings of which ancient people's philosophers does the idea of a spherical Earth first appear, around the 5th century BC?

timeline.labelEn: The idea of a spherical Earth first appears in the writings of Greek philosophers
timeline.labelDe: Die Vorstellung einer kugelförmigen Erde taucht erstmals in Schriften griechischer Philosophen auf

questions.notes: Wikipedia dates the earliest documented mention to around the 5th century BC; the card's attribution to Pythagoras (6th century BC) is the traditional later ascription, not documented in his time.
